dedupe_keys.name: sumo 24 hour car traffic simulations for boston lisbon los angeles rio de janeiro and san francisco eth zurich

description: This dataset provides ready-to-run files for simulating a full day of car traffic in five large cities with the open-source traffic simulator SUMO. It was published in 2022 in the ETH Zurich Research Collection by Lukas Ambühl, Monica Menendez and Marta C. González. Coverage: Boston, Los Angeles and San Francisco in the United States, Lisbon in Portugal and Rio de Janeiro in Brazil; for each city a car road network, a 24-hour trip-based car traffic demand and a SUMO configuration file. Format and access: SUMO net.xml networks, XML demand and configuration files packaged as ZIP archives of about 628 MB in total, downloadable from the ETH Research Collection under DOI 10.3929/ethz-b-000584669; free. Licence: not stated in the DataCite metadata read (the repository page was rate limited and not read). Caveats: car traffic only, without public transport, freight or pedestrians; how the demand was derived and calibrated is not described in the metadata; the subject keyword is traffic congestion. Simulation uses: city-scale network flow and congestion experiments, capacity planning and disruption or cascading failure tests on real urban road networks. Related records: Eclipse SUMO (model-sumo) runs the files, and the SUMO scenarios for Luxembourg (model-sumo-luxembourg-scenario-lust) and Monaco (model-sumo-monaco-scenario-most) are comparable city models.
